description: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 text-to-speech: the most emotive, highest-quality model with strong voice cloning, 90+ languages, multi-speaker dialogue, and a 10,000-character limit per request. Set the route provider model name to eleven_v4. Use the elevenlabs-tts adapter for OpenAI /v1/audio/speech (voice is an ElevenLabs voice_id), or ElevenLabs audio.speech passthrough for the native text-to-speech endpoints. Official list price $0.08 per 1K characters; billed per character. The gateway proxies the HTTP text-to-speech endpoints and the single-stream WebSocket stream-input endpoint (multi-stream-input is not supported); the WebSocket is billed by the characters the client sends. CNY price is the USD list price × 7 (placeholder, not an official RMB list price).

description: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 speech-to-text for POST /v1/speech-to-text (file transcription): 90+ languages, word-level timestamps, speaker diarization, and audio event tagging. Set the route provider model name to scribe_v2. Use elevenlabs-asr-file for OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions, or ElevenLabs audio.transcriptions passthrough for the native endpoint. Official list price $0.22 per hour; gateway meters by audio duration (per second). Optional keyterm prompting ($0.05/hour) and transcript editing ($0.07/hour) are billed extra by ElevenLabs and not included. CNY price is the USD list price × 7 (placeholder, not an official RMB list price).

i18n.zh: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Medical 语音转写，是 Scribe v2 针对临床音频的微调版本，对药名、解剖和病理术语识别更准。接口和价格与 Scribe v2 相同：POST /v1/speech-to-text，支持 90+ 种语言、词级时间戳和说话人识别。供应商模型名填 scribe_v2_medical。OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions 用适配器 elevenlabs-asr-file，原生端点用 audio.transcriptions 透传。官方刊例价 $0.22/小时；网关按音频时长（秒）计量。仅支持批量转写；关键词提示、转写编辑等附加功能由 ElevenLabs 另计费，不含在内。人民币价格为美元刊例价 ×7 的换算占位价，并非官方人民币刊例。

description: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime speech-to-text over WebSocket (GET /v1/speech-to-text/realtime): low-latency streaming transcription with partial and committed transcripts, 90+ languages. Set the route provider model name to scribe_v2_realtime and use the ElevenLabs audio.transcriptions.realtime passthrough; the OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint is not supported for this model. Official list price $0.39 per hour; the gateway meters per second from the audio bytes the client sends (using the session audio_format), so it is an estimate to reconcile against the ElevenLabs dashboard. Browsers cannot set the xi-api-key header: authenticate with the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol token octafuse-api-key.<key>. CNY price is the USD list price × 7 (placeholder, not an official RMB list price).

i18n.en: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime speech-to-text over WebSocket (GET /v1/speech-to-text/realtime): low-latency streaming transcription with partial and committed transcripts, 90+ languages. Set the route provider model name to scribe_v2_realtime and use the ElevenLabs audio.transcriptions.realtime passthrough; the OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint is not supported for this model. Official list price $0.39 per hour; the gateway meters per second from the audio bytes the client sends (using the session audio_format), so it is an estimate to reconcile against the ElevenLabs dashboard. Browsers cannot set the xi-api-key header: authenticate with the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol token octafuse-api-key.<key>. CNY price is the USD list price × 7 (placeholder, not an official RMB list price).
i18n.zh: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime 实时转写（WebSocket，GET /v1/speech-to-text/realtime）：低延迟流式转写，返回临时与已提交转写文本，支持 90+ 种语言。供应商模型名填 scribe_v2_realtime，路由适配器用 ElevenLabs audio.transcriptions.realtime 透传；该模型不支持 OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions。官方刊例价 $0.39/小时；网关按客户端发出的音频字节（结合会话的 audio_format）折算成秒计量，属估算，需与 ElevenLabs 控制台对账。浏览器无法设置 xi-api-key 请求头，请用 Sec-WebSocket-Protocol 子协议 octafuse-api-key.<key> 鉴权。人民币价格为美元刊例价 ×7 的换算占位价，并非官方人民币刊例。
